00.name: Narrator
00.text: In an ordinary forest, on an ordinary day, an ordinary lumberjack was going about his day.

01.name: Lumberjack
01.text: Wow! What a great day. The sun is out, there's not a cloud in the sky and a cool breeze is on the wind. I'm sure nothing can ruin this perfect day.

02.name: Narrator
02.text: An ominous wind blows down from the north.

03.name: Lumberjack
03.text: I'm sure that wind was nothing. It's time to get back to work. The faster I get this tree cut down the faster I can go to the tavern and get a frosty pint to cool me off.

04.name: Narrator
04.text: Use the 'wasd' or arrow keys in time with the music to chop the tree down.
